classes.name: StopWatch
classes.description: A class in Thunder::Core namespace used for measuring elapsed time.

methods.name: Elapsed
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time in microseconds since the stopwatch was started or last reset.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stopwatch and returns the elapsed time in microseconds at the moment of reset.
